<issue>
OAuth1 Client allows GET/HEAD requests with body parameters

#### Description

The OAuth1 Client no longer raises a ValueError when GET or HEAD requests include body parameters with form-urlencoded content type. This violates the HTTP 1.1 specification which states that GET and HEAD requests should not have semantic meaning in their body.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from oauthlib.oauth1 import Client

client = Client('client_key')

# This should raise ValueError but doesn't
client.sign(
    'http://example.com/path?query', 
    http_method='GET', 
    body='a=b', 
    headers={'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'}
)

# Same issue with HEAD requests
client.sign(
    'http://example.com/path?query', 
    http_method='HEAD', 
    body='a=b', 
    headers={'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'}
)
```

Expected behavior: Both calls should raise `ValueError('GET/HEAD requests should not include body.')`

Actual behavior: No exception is raised and the request is signed normally.
</issue>
